# ChessViewer

> Free, open-source chess diagram generator at chessvision.org. Paste a FEN position or set up the board, then export a print-ready PNG, JPEG or SVG diagram. Works in the browser with no sign-up.

To open a position directly, pass a URL-encoded FEN in the `fen` query parameter, for example `https://chessvision.org/?fen=8%2F8%2F8%2F4k3%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F4K3%20w%20-%20-%200%201`, or in the `position` fragment (`#position=...`). Fairy chess positions open in the fairy chess editor.

## Tools

- [Chess diagram generator](https://chessvision.org/): Convert a FEN position to a PNG, JPEG or SVG chess diagram.
- [Fairy chess editor](https://chessvision.org/fairy-chess): Create 8×8 fairy chess diagrams with neutral pieces, rotated symbols, Popeye pieces and conditions.
- [Batch export](https://chessvision.org/advanced-fen): Convert many FEN positions at once and download them as a ZIP archive.
- [LaTeX studio](https://chessvision.org/latex): Generate LaTeX for chess diagrams and problem collections with the skak, chessboard or chess-problem-diagrams packages.
- [Export settings](https://chessvision.org/export): Choose DPI, board size, background and file format for the exported diagram.
- [FEN history](https://chessvision.org/fen-history): Browse, search and re-export saved positions.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://chessvision.org/docs): How to use every part of ChessViewer, with detailed sections on [fairy chess](https://chessvision.org/docs?tab=fairy-chess) and [LaTeX Studio](https://chessvision.org/docs?tab=latex).

- [About ChessViewer](https://chessvision.org/about): Project background, privacy approach and support.
